jobs.list.title: List jobs
jobs.list.description: List public job postings via GET /posting-api/job-board/{boardName}/jobs.

candidates.list.title: List candidates
candidates.list.description: List candidates via authenticated POST /candidate.list. Optional limit, cursor, syncToken, and createdAfter filters.

applications.list.title: List applications
applications.list.description: List applications via authenticated POST /application.list. Optional limit, cursor, syncToken, createdAfter, status, and jobId filters.

candidates.get.title: Get candidate
candidates.get.description: Fetch a single candidate via authenticated POST /candidate.info. Requires id or externalMappingId.

applications.get.title: Get application
applications.get.description: Fetch a single application via authenticated POST /application.info. Requires applicationId or submittedFormInstanceId.

applications.create.title: Create application
applications.create.description: Consider a candidate for a job via authenticated POST /application.create. Requires candidateId and jobId. EffectPolicy Idempotent observes the created application via applications.get.

candidateId.description: Ashby candidate UUID to consider for a job.

creditedToUserId.description: Optional user UUID credited for the application.

interviewStageId.description: Optional interview stage UUID, or Ashby special string FirstPreInterviewScreen.

application.description: Normalized application after reconcile via applications.get.

candidates.search.title: Search candidates
candidates.search.description: Search candidates by email and/or name via authenticated POST /candidate.search. Requires email or name (AND-combined when both set). Not paginated; responses capped by Ashby (~100).

candidates.create.title: Create candidate
candidates.create.description: Create a candidate via authenticated POST /candidate.create. Requires name. AppCall websiteUrl maps to Ashby native body field website. EffectPolicy Idempotent observes the created candidate via candidates.get.

websiteUrl.description: Website URL. Mapped to Ashby native body field website.

sourceId.description: Source UUID credited on the candidate.

creditedToUserId.description: User UUID the candidate is credited to.

candidate.description: Normalized candidate after reconcile via candidates.get.

interviews.list.title: List interviews
interviews.list.description: List interview definitions via authenticated POST /interview.list. Optional limit, cursor, and syncToken filters.

applications.move.title: Move application
applications.move.description: Move an application to another interview stage via authenticated POST /application.changeStage. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes the post-move application via applications.get.

archiveReasonId.description: Archive reason UUID; required when moving to an Archived stage.

sendAt.description: Optional ISO-8601 send time for the archive email.

application.description: Normalized application after EffectPolicy Reconcile via applications.get.

applications.reject.title: Reject application
applications.reject.description: Reject (archive) an application via authenticated POST /application.changeStage to an Archived stage with archiveReasonId. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes the post-reject application via applications.get.

archiveReasonId.description: Archive reason UUID; required when moving to an Archived stage.

sendAt.description: Optional ISO-8601 send time for the archive email.

application.description: Normalized application after EffectPolicy Reconcile via applications.get.

applications.hire.title: Hire application
applications.hire.description: Hire a candidate by moving the application to a Hired interview stage via authenticated POST /application.changeStage. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes the post-hire application via applications.get.

archiveReasonId.description: Archive reason UUID; required when moving to an Archived stage.

sendAt.description: Optional ISO-8601 send time for the archive email.

application.description: Normalized application after EffectPolicy Reconcile via applications.get.

interviews.schedule.title: Schedule interview
interviews.schedule.description: Create an interview schedule via authenticated POST /interviewSchedule.create. Requires applicationId and interviewEvents (startTime, endTime, interviewers).

interviewSchedule.description: Normalized interview schedule returned by Ashby.

interviews.cancel.title: Cancel interview schedule
interviews.cancel.description: Cancel an interview schedule via authenticated POST /interviewSchedule.cancel. Maps interviewScheduleId to Ashby request body id.

interviewScheduleId.description: Interview schedule UUID (sent to Ashby as body.id).

allowReschedule.description: Whether the cancelled schedule may be rescheduled (default false).

interviewSchedule.description: Normalized interview schedule returned by Ashby.

jobs.get.title: Get job
jobs.get.description: Fetch a single job via authenticated POST /job.info. Requires id.

candidates.update.title: Update candidate
candidates.update.description: Update a candidate via authenticated POST /candidate.update. AppCall id maps to Ashby body candidateId; websiteUrl is sent as Ashby websiteUrl. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via candidates.get.

websiteUrl.description: Website URL. Sent as Ashby body field websiteUrl.

sourceId.description: Source UUID credited on the candidate.

creditedToUserId.description: User UUID the candidate is credited to.

candidate.description: Normalized candidate after EffectPolicy Reconcile via candidates.get.

offers.list.title: List offers
offers.list.description: List offers via authenticated POST /offer.list. Optional limit, cursor, syncToken, and applicationId filters.

offers.get.title: Get offer
offers.get.description: Fetch a single offer via authenticated POST /offer.info. Requires offerId.

departments.list.title: List departments
departments.list.description: List departments via authenticated POST /department.list. Optional limit, cursor, and syncToken filters.

users.list.title: List users
users.list.description: List users via authenticated POST /user.list. Optional limit, cursor, and syncToken filters.

sources.list.title: List sources
sources.list.description: List candidate sources via authenticated POST /source.list. Optional limit, cursor, and syncToken filters.

archive_reasons.list.title: List archive reasons
archive_reasons.list.description: List archive reasons via authenticated POST /archiveReason.list. Optional limit, cursor, and syncToken filters.

interview_schedules.list.title: List interview schedules
interview_schedules.list.description: List interview schedules via authenticated POST /interviewSchedule.list. Optional limit, cursor, and syncToken filters.

interview_stages.list.title: List interview stages
interview_stages.list.description: List interview stages for one interview plan via POST /interviewStage.list. Requires interviewPlanId.

openings.list.title: List openings
openings.list.description: List job openings via authenticated POST /opening.list. Optional limit, cursor, and syncToken filters.

candidates.create_note.title: Create candidate note
candidates.create_note.description: Create a note on a candidate via authenticated POST /candidate.createNote. Requires candidateId and note. No effect keys (no note get).

note.description: Note body as a plain string or Ashby {type, value} object.

candidates.list_notes.title: List candidate notes
candidates.list_notes.description: List notes on a candidate via authenticated POST /candidate.listNotes. Requires candidateId. Optional limit, cursor, and syncToken.

candidates.add_tag.title: Add candidate tag
candidates.add_tag.description: Add a tag to a candidate via authenticated POST /candidate.addTag. Requires candidateId and tagId.get does not expose tags. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via candidates.get (tags).

candidate_tags.list.title: List candidate tags
candidate_tags.list.description: List candidate tags via authenticated POST /candidateTag.list. Optional includeArchived, limit, cursor, and syncToken.

candidate_tags.create.title: Create candidate tag
candidate_tags.create.description: Create a candidate tag via authenticated POST /candidateTag.create. Requires title. No effect keys (no tag get).

applications.change_source.title: Change application source
applications.change_source.description: Change an application's source via authenticated POST /application.changeSource. Requires applicationId and sourceId.get does not expose source. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via applications.get (sourceId).

applications.transfer.title: Transfer application
applications.transfer.description: Transfer an application to another job via authenticated POST /application.transfer. Requires applicationId, jobId, interviewPlanId, and interviewStageId. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via applications.get (jobId/stageId).

startAutomaticActivities.description: Whether to start automatic activities on transfer.

applications.update.title: Update application
applications.update.description: Update an application via authenticated POST /application.update. Requires applicationId. Optional sourceId, creditedToUserId, createdAt, sendNotifications.get does not expose source or creditedToUser. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via applications.get (sourceId/creditedToUserId).

applications.list_history.title: List application history
applications.list_history.description: List application history via authenticated POST /application.listHistory. Requires applicationId. Optional limit and cursor.

application_feedback.list.title: List application feedback
application_feedback.list.description: List application feedback via authenticated POST /applicationFeedback.list. Optional applicationId, createdAfter, limit, cursor, and syncToken.

application_feedback.submit.title: Submit application feedback
application_feedback.submit.description: Submit application feedback via authenticated POST /applicationFeedback.submit. Requires applicationId, formDefinitionId, and feedbackForm. No effect keys (no feedback get).

feedbackForm.description: Map of form field path to submitted value.

hiring_team.add_member.title: Add hiring team member
hiring_team.add_member.description: Add a user to a hiring team via authenticated POST /hiringTeam.addMember. Requires teamMemberId, roleId, and exactly one of applicationId, jobId, or openingId. No effect keys.

roleId.description: Hiring team role id or name.

hiring_team.remove_member.title: Remove hiring team member
hiring_team.remove_member.description: Remove a user from a hiring team via authenticated POST /hiringTeam.removeMember. Requires teamMemberId, roleId, and exactly one of applicationId, jobId, or openingId. No effect keys.

roleId.description: Hiring team role id or name.

hiring_team_roles.list.title: List hiring team roles
hiring_team_roles.list.description: List hiring team roles via authenticated POST /hiringTeamRole.list. Requires namesOnly (boolean).

namesOnly.description: When true, results are role name strings.

users.get.title: Get user
users.get.description: Fetch a user via authenticated POST /user.info. Requires userId.

jobs.list_internal.title: List jobs (internal)
jobs.list_internal.description: List internal jobs via authenticated POST /job.list. Distinct from public jobs.list (posting board). Agent tool.

createdAfter.description: Unix ms; jobs created at or after.

jobs.search.title: Search jobs
jobs.search.description: Search jobs by title or custom requisition id via authenticated POST /job.search. At least one of title or requisitionId is required. Agent tool.

jobs.create.title: Create job
jobs.create.description: Create a job via authenticated POST /job.create. Requires title, teamId, and locationId. No effect keys (creates always omit; a retry after a lost response would double-POST).

jobs.update.title: Update job
jobs.update.description: Update a job via authenticated POST /job.update. Requires jobId and at least one other field. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via jobs.get.

jobs.set_status.title: Set job status
jobs.set_status.description: Set a job status via authenticated POST /job.setStatus. Requires jobId and status. Optional closeReasonId when Closed. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via jobs.get.

closeReasonId.description: Close reason UUID when setting Closed.

job_templates.list.title: List job templates
job_templates.list.description: List job templates via authenticated POST /jobTemplate.list. Agent tool.

job_interview_plans.get.title: Get job interview plan
job_interview_plans.get.description: Fetch a job interview plan via authenticated POST /jobInterviewPlan.info. Requires jobId. Agent tool.

job_postings.list.title: List job postings
job_postings.list.description: List job postings via authenticated POST /jobPosting.list. Agent tool.

job_postings.get.title: Get job posting
job_postings.get.description: Fetch a job posting via authenticated POST /jobPosting.info. Requires jobPostingId. Observe for job_postings.update. Agent tool.

job_postings.update.title: Update job posting
job_postings.update.description: Update a job posting via authenticated POST /jobPosting.update. Requires jobPostingId. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via job_postings.get.

openings.get.title: Get opening
openings.get.description: Fetch an opening via authenticated POST /opening.info. Requires openingId (or id alias for Idempotent observe from openings.create). Observe for openings.create/update. Agent tool.

id.description: Alias for openingId (Idempotent observe injects top-level id).

openings.search.title: Search openings
openings.search.description: Search openings by identifier via authenticated POST /opening.search. Requires identifier. Agent tool.

openings.create.title: Create opening
openings.create.description: Create an opening via authenticated POST /opening.create. No required body fields. No effect keys (creates always omit; a retry after a lost response would double-POST).

isBackfill.description: Whether this opening is a backfill.

openings.update.title: Update opening
openings.update.description: Update an opening via authenticated POST /opening.update. Requires openingId. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via openings.get.

isBackfill.description: Whether this opening is a backfill.

close_reasons.list.title: List close reasons
close_reasons.list.description: List job/opening close reasons via authenticated POST /closeReason.list. Agent tool.
